name: Nikolai
source:
He is a thief, but of the aladdin type. He is a scoundrel, but he won't hurt people or take from those that can't afford to have things taken. Naturally, it's left him a little worse off, but he takes his moral code seriously. He masks himself behind an upbeat air, pretending to be a gentleman thief, but in actuality, he's just a scared kid doing what he has to in order to survive.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25899]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
